evaluation_assumptions.rolling_evaluation: At interval T, the baseline prediction uses the modeled intensity from T-48 intervals (T - 24 hours), which was fully finalized 24 hours prior to prediction time.
evaluation_assumptions.zero_leakage: No observation at or after prediction time T is used. All inputs are strictly backward-looking.
evaluation_assumptions.mape_zero_handling: In both 2023 and 2024, modeled carbon intensity values are strictly positive (min 26.0 gCO2/kWh in 2023, min 14.0 gCO2/kWh in 2024), so division by zero does not occur.
